_real_world.class: Large Aperture Bow (LAB) water-backed passive bow sonar with BQQ-10 processing
_real_world.variant_scope: Virginia-class SSN-784 and later (Block III/IV in this OOB).

_provenance.modeling_note: Passive bow sonar for Virginia Block III/IV, replacing the spherical array of earlier Virginia blocks with a larger water-backed array. No public detection range exists (R18/R19); values are engineering estimates patterned on the repo's existing passive hull-sonar MVP calibration, scaled up modestly for a larger dedicated-submarine bow array versus a surface-ship hull sonar.

sonar.mode.note: LAB array + BQQ-10 is a passive listening system

sonar.max_range_m.note: not public (R18/R19); engineering estimate scaled up from the repo passive hull-sonar MVP baseline for a dedicated large-aperture SSN bow array

sonar.scan_period_s.note: no public figure; carried close to the repo passive hull-sonar MVP baseline

sonar.detection_threshold_db.note: no public figure; engineering estimate slightly better than the repo hull-sonar MVP baseline, reflecting a larger dedicated SSN array

sonar.track_memory_s.note: no public figure; engineering estimate close to the repo hull-sonar MVP baseline

sonar.bearing_noise_std_deg.note: no public figure; engineering estimate slightly better than the repo hull-sonar MVP baseline for a larger aperture array

sonar.range_noise_std_m.note: no public figure; engineering estimate close to the repo hull-sonar MVP baseline

sonar.directivity_gain_db.note: no public figure; engineering estimate slightly above the repo hull-sonar MVP baseline for a larger water-backed array

sonar.self_noise_per_speed_db.note: no public figure; engineering estimate slightly better than the repo hull-sonar MVP baseline, reflecting a quieter nuclear-submarine hull

sonar.ambient_noise_db.note: no public figure; engineering estimate close to the repo hull-sonar MVP baseline

sonar.source_level_reference_db.note: 0.0: LAB/BQQ-10 is passive-only, no active source level applies

sonar.source_level_speed_factor_db.note: 0.0: passive-only system, no active source-level speed dependency

sonar.transmission_loss_alpha_db_per_km.note: no public figure; carried close to the repo hull-sonar MVP baseline (generic underwater transmission-loss constant)

sonar.layer_break_penalty_db.note: no public figure; carried close to the repo hull-sonar MVP baseline

sonar.convergence_zone_bonus_m.note: no public figure; engineering estimate scaled with max_range_m

sonar.baffle_exclusion_deg.note: no public figure; engineering estimate close to the repo hull-sonar MVP baseline (bow-mounted array's stern baffle exclusion)

sonar.ownship_quieting_speed_mps.note: no public figure; engineering estimate close to the repo hull-sonar MVP baseline

sonar.active_ping_source_level_db.note: 0.0: LAB/BQQ-10 is passive-only, no active ping capability modeled

sonar.confirm_hits_m.note: standard engine detection-confirmation default, not sourced per-platform

sonar.confirm_window_n.note: standard engine detection-confirmation default, not sourced per-platform

sonar.passive_only.note: LAB array + BQQ-10 has no active transmit mode

sonar.bearing_only.note: false: LAB is a large-aperture array capable of range estimation via beamforming, not bearing-only
